scope: Securities Transaction Tax on NSE exchange-traded equity derivatives (index and stock options and futures). Each rate applies to trades executed ON OR AFTER effective_from, until the next entry.
coverage_note: Dates before coverage_from are NOT covered: the start date of the 0.017% option-sale rate (Finance Act 2013) was not opened from a primary source in this pass. A cost lookup before coverage_from is refused, never guessed.
